julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant teal (#00FFCC) to evoke a sense of grounded optimism and atmospheric tech. The color represents the glowing neon of back-alley cybernetics shops where genuine human connection still thrives amidst the machinery.
storyPanel: In the lower wards, a retired maintenance synth shares a quiet cup of synthetic tea with a young mechanic. The neon glow of their workshop hums softly, casting warm light on hands stained with grease and wire. It's hard work keeping the old grid running, but the laughter shared over patched circuits makes every sparked fuse worth it.
